name: io.github.askads/mcp-yandex-webmaster
title: Yandex Webmaster MCP
description: MCP server for Yandex Webmaster API: indexing, search queries, sitemaps, diagnostics, links.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_OAUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Yandex OAuth token with Webmaster access, sent as `Authorization: OAuth <token>`. Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Token owner's user id; auto-detected via GET /v4/user when unset.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WEBMASTER_HOST_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default host_id (e.g. https:example.com:443) used when a tool call omits one.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WEBMASTER_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 — except the daily QUOTA_EXCEEDED; 5xx/network for reads).
